title: code-index.v1
description: legacy-code-intel SCIP-inspired custom code-intelligence index for a single artifact. Symbol / occurrence / relationship triad (SCIP's package and type hierarchy dropped). ~75% shared core + per-format symbol.kind enum + an open attributes{} bag for per-format extras. Produced by emit_index.py from accumulated per-chunk findings; schema-validated before store.persist. Symbol IDs are content-hash-based (codelib://sha256/<artifact_hash>#sym/<scoped-name>), NEVER path-derived. Draft-07, lowercase types throughout (anti-requirement vs the discarded agy build which used uppercase STRING/OBJECT and could never validate).

schema_version.description: Index schema version. Additive-only; a breaking change bumps the major and forces re-extraction via the pipeline fingerprint.

extractor_version.description: SemVer of the extractor scripts. Part of the pipeline fingerprint.

symbols.description: All symbols defined or referenced in this artifact. Empty array is valid.

occurrences.description: Definition and reference occurrences of symbols, with line ranges, evidence and confidence.

relationships.description: Typed edges between symbols (contains / calls / reads / writes / copies / references / schedules).

refs.description: Path-side reverse index. Symbol IDs are path-independent; this maps the artifact's source path(s) so cross-artifact path lookups still work.

by_path.description: source_path -> list of symbol_ids defined in that path. additionalProperties:true because paths are arbitrary keys.

gaps.description: Honest disclosure of unresolved static-analysis lossiness (dynamic CALL, COPY REPLACING rename, DSX RCP, unsupported format, etc.).

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the entire artifact content. Half of the dedup key.

format.description: Auto-detected artifact format. Scope: COBOL, DataStage DSX, ETL (shell/SQL/Python), Pick/MultiValue BASIC (UniVerse/UniData/D3/jBASE/OpenQM).

source_path.description: Path the artifact was ingested from. Forward-slash separator. Informational only; NOT part of the symbol ID.

ingested_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC ingest timestamp, OR the literal 'SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH' sentinel when deterministic output is forced (HARD-RULE 3).

model_id.description: Identifier of the LLM/CLI that performed extraction (e.g. claude-code, codex-cli, agy, copilot-cli, or a test sentinel). Part of the pipeline fingerprint so a model change re-extracts.

prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the concatenated extraction prompt set. Part of the pipeline fingerprint.

pipeline_fingerprint.description: sha256(schema_version + prompt_hash + extractor_version + model_id + normalizer_version). The OTHER half of the dedup key (with content_sha256). A prompt/model/extractor bump produces a NEW fingerprint so the store re-extracts instead of false-hitting a stale cache (anti-requirement vs the discarded agy build which trusted an unset field).

cost.description: Optional best-effort cost metadata. Open bag.

symbol_id.description: Path-INDEPENDENT content-addressed symbol ID: codelib://sha256/<artifact_hash>#sym/<scoped-name>. Content-hash dedup conflicts with path-derived IDs; the same copybook in two repos must resolve identically. Paths live in refs.by_path, NOT in the ID.

kind.description: Per-format symbol kind. Validated against the format-specific enum in code-finding.v1.json at chunk time. COBOL {program,division,section,paragraph,data_item,copybook,file_descriptor,call_target}; DSX {job,stage,link,column,parameter,container,routine,sequence}; ETL {function,variable,sql_cte,table,call_target,shell_task}; Pick {program,subroutine,paragraph,dict_item,file,common_block,label,variable}.

name.description: Human-readable symbol name (paragraph name, stage name, function name).

signature.description: Optional signature/declaration text (e.g. PIC clause, parameter list).

container_symbol_id.description: Optional enclosing symbol (e.g. the section that contains a paragraph). Used to render the contains relationship.

attributes.description: Open per-format extras bag (e.g. COBOL level number, DSX stage type). additionalProperties:true by design.

role.description: Whether this occurrence defines the symbol or references it.

evidence_snippet.description: Source text supporting the occurrence. Passes through fail-closed redaction (HARD-RULE 1) before any store write.

confidence.description: Bright-line classifier (HARD-RULE 2). Interpolation / dynamic CALL / COPY REPLACING / DSX RCP => forced speculative.

confidence_reason.description: Short machine-readable reason code for the confidence tier.

boundary_issue.description: True when an unpaired/ambiguous chunk-boundary partial forced a speculative downgrade during accumulate.

evidence_line.description: Line where the relationship is established (0 if synthesized from containment).

kind.description: Gap class: dynamic_call, copy_replacing_rename, dsx_rcp, unsupported_format, oversized_file, binary_file, unresolved_symbol, boundary_issue, etc.
